test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Girls should take special care with respect to health and hygiene during the time of menstrual flow to avoid infections and ill health. Which of the following statements in this regard is FALSE?

options.text: Girls should consume chips and packed or tinned snacks to meet nutritional needs.
Girls should use sanitary napkins or clean homemade pads.
Girls should keep track of their menstrual cycle and be prepared for the onset of menstruation.
Girls should change pads after every 4-5 hours or as per the requirement.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Girls should consume chips and packed or tinned snacks to meet nutritional needs**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Good menstrual hygiene and health habits will help you avoid infections, lessen odours, and keep you at ease while you're on your period.**

 
 
• **Prior to using a menstruation product, wash your hands both before and after using the restroom.**
 
• Used menstruation products should be properly disposed of.
 
• Regardless of how little the flow is, change sanitary pads every few hours. If your period is heavy, change them more regularly.
 
• **A single tampon should not be worn for longer than 8 hours at a time.**
 
• **Every day after use, clean the cups. After your period has ended, sanitise menstruation cups by giving them a good rinse and then putting them in a pot of boiling water for one to two minutes.**
 
• The **majority of washable period underwear is made to be reused.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• While on your period, you may maintain your health and comfort by following these **hygiene precautions:**

 
 
• **Put on breathable, lightweight clothing (such as cotton underwear).** Tight clothing can keep heat and moisture in, which helps bacteria grow.

 Regularly replace your menstruation products.
 
• **Maintain a clean genital area. **Every day, wash the outside of your vagina and bottom.
 
• **Use pads, tampons, or toilet paper without scents.** The skin can become inflamed, and your natural pH balance can be affected by scented hygiene products.
 
• **Obtain plenty of liquids.** By washing out your urinary system, you can avoid diseases like vaginal candidiasis.
 
• **Keep tabs on your period. **Your menstrual cycle serves as an important barometer of your general health. Period irregularities may indicate health issues like diabetes, thyroid issues, or celiac disease.
